messages:
jana_cs: FYI escalation from Biyu (payment app) — after last night's canary they report Chinese responses have shifted tone and are using informal first-person forms where they were previously formal. example below. :eyes:

liwei_customer: sharing samples from prod (redacted):
Prompt: "请把下面的银行通知翻译成中文，保持正式且面向客户：
'Your payment is due on April 30. Please log in to pay.'"
Expected: "您的付款截止日期为4月30日。请登录并完成付款。"
Actual (post-rollout): "你得在4月30号交钱，记得去登录付一下。"

jana_cs: They say it started ~30 minutes after canary reached 20% traffic in asia-east1. No API errors, latency normal. Reported both Simplified Chinese and occasional English code-switching (e.g. 'login' left in English).

deploy-bot: canary rollout rwd-model-2.7 -> rwd-model-2.8-candidate started by rob_eng at 1769997000, step: 20% traffic asia-east1

anya_ml: tagging: @rob_eng @mike_sre — can you paste model id + tokenizer revision? This smells like a tokenization/decoding change or prompt-template drift. Also need temperature/params used by customer.

liwei_customer: curl repro (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-model-2.8-candidate","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a formal translator."},{"role":"user","content":"请把下面的银行通知翻译成中文，保持正式且面向客户：'Your payment is due on April 30. Please log in to pay.'"}],"temperature":0.2}'
```
Response body (trimmed):
```
{ "id": "gen_abc123", "output": "你得在4月30号交钱，记得去登录付一下。" }
```

rob_eng: Confirmed the canary did flip tokenizer-rev from tknr-v2 -> tknr-v3 at 1769996900 as part of a compression/consistency change. That change is in the candidate. We did not expect surface-level style changes but tknr-v3 includes a new punctuation normalization.

kelly_support: Suggested mitigation to customer: temporary pin to rwd-model-2.7 (previous stable) while we investigate. Customer asked if rollback possible without downtime.

mike_sre: Not seeing infra errors. Observability shows KV-cache warmup issues right after the canary started (cache miss rate spiked for zh locale shards). Might cause model to recompute prefixes -> small prompt context differences.

anya_ml: Possible root causes to triage: tokenizer mapping change, decoding sampling bug, or inadvertent sysprompt change in the staged config. Can someone dump exact tokenization of the phrase on both tokenizer revisions? e.g. token lists for "您的付款截止日期为4月30日" vs generated output.

liwei_customer: Added another failing example where named entity remained english: prompt asked to translate 'log in' -> customer got 'login' (English). They depend on strict locale transformations for UI copy.

observability-bot: trace rwd-model-2.8-candidate / request gen_abc123: region=asia-east1 latency=320ms tokens_in=24 tokens_out=18 route=canary-20%

rob_eng: I'll roll back tokenizer-rev on candidate and run quick A/B test. If that isn't the cause we'll revert the canary entirely.

anya_ml: In parallel, please collect: full request/response pair (no PII), tokenizer dumps for v2/v3, decoding params (top_k/top_p/temperature), and any prompt-template overrides. I'll run a small repro harness locally.

jana_cs: Customer accepted temporary pin to 2.7 for now. They've asked for ETA — I'll update when eng confirms rollback. :thumbsup:

kelly_support: Filing follow-up ticket to account team, adding patch notes summary for customer communication.

rob_eng: Update: rolled tokenizer-rev back in candidate at 1769998800 and re-routed 20% to candidate->candidate-rollback. Early checks show translation tone matches stable on 10 sample prompts. Waiting on customer sanbox validation.

liwei_customer: Will validate now and report back within the hour. Thanks all.

anya_ml: If customer repros stop after rollback we'll mark this as tokenizer-induced regression. If not, escalate to decoding/beam-search differences.

mike_sre: Logging: created incident stub INC-2026-2311 for tracking root cause and postmortem.

liwei_customer: Validation: 3/3 sample prompts now produce the expected formal phrasing. Rolling back in prod solved it for us. We'll keep testing and will ping if we see more.

jana_cs: Closing loop with Biyu, marking as mitigated. We'll keep INC open until postmortem. Thanks everyone. :tada:
